about: Closest passages across the books. Each pair is one verse's best match in the other book, scored by a mix of word-vector cosine and TF-IDF cosine. Refrains, very short verses and pairs that share fewer than 2 informative words are left out, each verse is used once, and no chapter appears more than 2 times per pair of books. Themes are hand-named; each pair is put under the closest one by word vectors, so a few placements are rough.

a.text: And of them is he who defameth thee in the matter of the alms. If they are given thereof they are content, and if they are not given thereof, behold! they are enraged.

b.text: That alms given to one who does nothing in return, believing that a gift ought to be made in a fit place and time to a worthy person, that alms is accounted pure.

a.text: (Alms are) for the poor who are straitened for the cause of Allah, who cannot travel in the land (for trade). The unthinking man accounteth them wealthy because of their restraint. Thou shalt know them by their mark: They do not beg of men with importunity. And whatsoever good thing ye spend, lo! Allah knoweth it.

b.text: "I am wealthy, well-born; what other is there that is like unto me? I will sacrifice, I will give alms, I will rejoice." Thus deluded by unwisdom,

a.text: So keep your duty to Allah as best ye can, and listen, and obey, and spend; that is better for your souls. And whoso is saved from his own greed, such are the successful.

b.text: Better one's own duty, though destitute of merit, than the duty of another, well discharged. Better death in the discharge of one's own duty; the duty of another is full of danger.

a.text: But every vow of a widow, and of her that is divorced, wherewith they have bound their souls, shall stand against her.

a.text: And thou shalt come from thy place out of the north parts, thou, and many people with thee, all of them riding upon horses, a great company, and a mighty army:

b.text: And that which Allah gave as spoil unto His messenger from them, ye urged not any horse or riding-camel for the sake thereof, but Allah giveth His messenger lordship over whom He will. Allah is Able to do all things.

a.text: Remember his marvellous works that he hath done; his wonders, and the judgments of his mouth;

a.text: Praise ye the LORD. O give thanks unto the LORD; for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.

a.text: And he arose, and rebuked the wind, and said unto the sea, Peace, be still. And the wind ceased, and there was a great calm.

a.text: To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David. I waited patiently for the LORD; and he inclined unto me, and heard my cry.

b.text: So wait patiently (O Muhammad) for thy Lord's decree, for surely thou art in Our sight; and hymn the praise of thy Lord when thou uprisest,

b.text: Ye should believe in Allah and His messenger, and should strive for the cause of Allah with your wealth and your lives. That is better for you, if ye did but know.

themes.name: Death, judgment and the life to come

a.text: For to this end Christ both died, and rose, and revived, that he might be Lord both of the dead and living.

b.text: Have they not travelled in the land, and have they hearts wherewith to feel and ears wherewith to hear? For indeed it is not the eyes that grow blind, but it is the hearts, which are within the bosoms, that grow blind.

a.text: I thank thee, and praise thee, O thou God of my fathers, who hast given me wisdom and might, and hast made known unto me now what we desired of thee: for thou hast now made known unto us the king's matter.

b.text: I will declare to thee this knowledge and wisdom in its completeness, which, having known, there is nothing more here needeth to be known.

a.text: For God is not the author of confusion, but of peace, as in all churches of the saints.

b.text: These worlds would fall into ruin, if I did not perform action; I should be the author of confusion of castes, and should destroy these creatures.

a.text: For the LORD giveth wisdom: out of his mouth cometh knowledge and understanding.

b.text: Constancy in the wisdom of the Self, understanding of the object of essential wisdom; that is declared to be the Wisdom; all against it is ignorance.

a.text: Howbeit we speak wisdom among them that are perfect: yet not the wisdom of this world, nor of the princes of this world, that come to nought:

b.text: Verily there is no purifier in this world like wisdom; he that is perfected in yoga finds it in the Self in due season.

a.text: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, If a soul shall sin through ignorance against any of the commandments of the LORD concerning things which ought not to be done, and shall do against any of them:

b.text: Therefore let the Scriptures be thy authority, in determining what ought to be done, or what ought not to be done. Knowing what hath been declared by the ordinances of the Scriptures, thou oughtest to work in this world.

a.text: A talebearer revealeth secrets: but he that is of a faithful spirit concealeth the matter.

b.text: That is because they say unto those who hate what Allah hath revealed: We will obey you in some matters; and Allah knoweth their secret talk.

a.text: A scorner seeketh wisdom, and findeth it not: but knowledge is easy unto him that understandeth.

b.text: Moses said: Lo! I seek refuge in my Lord and your Lord from every scorner who believeth not in a Day of Reckoning.

a.text: And keep your opinion secret or proclaim it, lo! He is Knower of all that is in the breasts (of men).

b.text: Understand Me as the Knower of the Field in all Fields, O Bharata. Wisdom as to the Field and the Knower of the Field, that in My opinion is the wisdom.

a.text: Those who disbelieve and turn (men) from the way of Allah, He rendereth their actions vain.

b.text: Let no wise man unsettle the mind of ignorant people attached to action; but acting in harmony with Me let him render all action attractive.

a.text: But the righteousness which is of faith speaketh on this wise, Say not in thine heart, Who shall ascend into heaven? (that is, to bring Christ down from above:)

b.text: He it is Who sent down peace of reassurance into the hearts of the believers that they might add faith unto their faith. Allah's are the hosts of the heavens and the earth, and Allah is ever Knower, Wise -

a.text: Allah's are the hosts of the heavens and the earth, and Allah is ever Mighty, Wise.

b.text: "Behold this mighty host of the sons of Pandu, O teacher, arrayed by the son of Drupada, thy wise disciple.

a.text: Lo! Allah is the Knower of the Unseen of the heavens and the earth. Lo! He is Aware of the secret of (men's) breasts.

b.text: Of rulers I am the sceptre; of those that seek victory I am statesmanship; and of secrets I am also silence; the knowledge of knowers am I.

a.text: Our Lord! And raise up in their midst a messenger from among them who shall recite unto them Thy revelations, and shall instruct them in the Scripture and in wisdom and shall make them grow. Lo! Thou, only Thou, art the Mighty, Wise.

b.text: Learn thou this by discipleship, by investigation, and by service. The wise, the seers of the essence of things, will instruct thee in wisdom.

a.text: Before the LORD: for he cometh, for he cometh to judge the earth: he shall judge the world with righteousness, and the people with his truth.

b.text: Say: Our Lord will bring us all together, then He will judge between us with truth. He is the All-knowing Judge.

a.text: I lead in the way of righteousness, in the midst of the paths of judgment:

b.text: O my father! Lo! there hath come unto me of knowledge that which came not unto thee. So follow me, and I will lead thee on a right path.

a.text: Lead me, O LORD, in thy righteousness because of mine enemies; make thy way straight before my face.

b.text: And Allah summoneth to the abode of peace, and leadeth whom He will to a straight path.

a.text: And Jesus answering said unto them, Do ye not therefore err, because ye know not the scriptures, neither the power of God?

b.text: Those who disbelieve among the People of the Scripture and the idolaters could not have left off (erring) till the clear proof came unto them,

a.text: And said to the judges, Take heed what ye do: for ye judge not for man, but for the LORD, who is with you in the judgment.

b.text: Therefor judge Thou between us, a (conclusive) judgment, and save me and those believers who are with me.

a.text: And thou shalt do according to the sentence, which they of that place which the LORD shall choose shall shew thee; and thou shalt observe to do according to all that they inform thee:

b.text: O ye who believe! Observe your duty to Allah. And let every soul look to that which it sendeth on before for the morrow. And observe your duty to Allah. Lo! Allah is Informed of what ye do.

a.text: And when we heard the guidance, we believed therein, and whoso believeth in his Lord, he feareth neither loss nor oppression.

b.text: In this there is no loss of effort, nor is there transgression. Even a little of this knowledge protects from great fear.

a.text: Art thou not from everlasting, O LORD my God, mine Holy One? we shall not die. O LORD, thou hast ordained them for judgment; and, O mighty God, thou hast established them for correction.

b.text: Or have ye a covenant on oath from Us that reacheth to the Day of Judgment, that yours shall be all that ye ordain?
